name: Tateshina Euvely Mcbride
original_name: 蓼科 イウヴァリー マクブライド
source:
[b]The Aikido Master: Police Agency's Secret Trickster[/b]

This second-year powerhouse serves as the Athletic Director, commanding all sports clubs on campus. Though she's clinched national championships in Aikido, Eve stays remarkably grounded. Her way of treating everyone with equal courtesy, regardless of status, has won her genuine admiration across the entire student body.

Still, there might be more to this daughter of the National Police Commissioner than meets the eye. Word is she joined the student council on some classified mission... or has she?

"Listen up~ Marriage needs real love, you know? Not some business deal - can't just crunch the numbers!"

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://selectoblige.com/character]official website[/url]]
